integrity: The characteristic factor is derived from direct differentiation of the printed nonlinear system; numerical values are reproducible from the published parameter set. Search-based originality assessment is non-exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Local spectral correction only: no nonlinear Hopf direction or periodic-orbit stability is claimed, and no assertion is made about all delays beyond the first crossing.
title: Correct characteristic factor and first delay crossing in an awareness-mediated epidemic model
